title: Student Assistant
description_md:
Are you studying data, analytics, or business and want hands-on experience with a modern data platform in a global company?

As a Student Assistant in the Data Platform & Insight team, you'll help build and improve the dashboards and analytics solutions that colleagues across a global maritime business use every day and help more people get value from our data.
